headline: New Zork Times Begins Publication Despite Limited Public Demand
dek: The city's newest newspaper arrives with one editor, no printing press, and an uncertain publication schedule.
excerpt: The New Zork Times officially began publication Friday morning, promising news, commentary and whatever else survives the editorial meeting.

body.text: NEW ZORK — The New Zork Times officially began publication Friday morning, entering an already crowded media landscape with a staff of approximately one person and a business model that remains under active investigation.
The publication will cover local events, technology, sports, culture, opinion and subjects that editors describe only as "important enough at the time."

Unlike traditional newspapers, the Times will exist entirely online. Management reportedly considered purchasing a printing press before determining that the financial and logistical requirements were inconsistent with the current newsroom budget.
We remain committed to producing journalism without accidentally purchasing industrial machinery.
Each edition will be assembled from individually published stories, allowing articles to remain accessible through permanent links while also appearing within dated issues.
The Times declined to commit to a weekly, monthly or otherwise predictable publication schedule. Readers were advised to check back whenever they remember.
